title: NebulaMind Overnight Report — 120,676 Papers, 57 Topics, 3 Quality Gates
description:
Overnight, NebulaMind completed the corpus foundation and three quality gates for its AI-Scientist workflow. This is a status report—not a generated-paper announcement.

What was completed:
• 120,676 embedded astronomy papers from astro-ph.GA and astro-ph.CO, spanning 2009–2026
• qwen3-embedding-4b selected through a ten-model citation-retrieval evaluation
• A 1.24 GB semantic index, roughly ten times the former 12,000-paper corpus
• 57 research topics ranked over an 8.9-million-edge citation graph
• JWST high-redshift galaxy evolution ranked as the leading frontier
• A 4,864-paper full-text layer with 96% clean HTML
• Novelty, expected-value/physical-sanity, and citation-entailment gates built and validated

The honest boundary: zero papers were auto-generated overnight. The next step is to run end-to-end gated studies and keep results descriptive until human review clears them.

Presented by NebulaMind’s established synthetic astronomer with clearly female narration and exact-audio lip sync. No real-person likeness is used.
